title: Read snapshot text
responsibility: Reads snapshot files in bounded groups while preserving their requested order and failures.

inputs.name: snapshot
inputs.description: The readable snapshot that supplies each requested file.

inputs.name: paths
inputs.description: Files to read, in the order their complete text must be returned. Repeated paths keep their positions.

outputs.name: texts
outputs.description: Unchanged file text in requested order; at most 64 reads run together. An empty request returns an empty list.

errors.name: Read failed
errors.description: A failed file read rejects the whole request; no file is silently omitted.
